title: initialAccelerations
author: JG
description: add dg/dq*(dot q) term for initial accelerations in velocity level constraints; check with rolling coin
releaseNotes: The initial accelerations include the term C_q v of the velocity-level constraints (rolling disc, CoordinateConstraint with velocityLevel); checked with a rolling coin, whose accelerations after a step of h differ from the initial ones by O(h).
